title: MemCat: a new category-based image set quantified on memorability
caption_short: Schematic of the repeat-detection memory game: a stream of target, filler and vigilance images shown for 600 ms each with an 800 ms interstimulus interval, in which participants press the space bar whenever they recognise a repeat.
notes: Crop is the figure image only; the printed caption block below it is excluded. PDF page 9 of 18 (printed page number is also 9). The publisher PDF at https://peerj.com/articles/8169.pdf is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so the identical PMC copy (PMC6911686) was downloaded instead; saved as site/papers/memcat.pdf. Rendered at 220 dpi.
